owner_and_capability: Architecture policy (backend/architecture/policy.json, checker backend/internal/architecture) grants the standing composition and test reaches of ADR 0053, points 2, 3, 7 and 9, in policy epoch 40 -> 41: the typed roots (root-composition: api, cmd, .) reach the compose, public, contract, port and http roles of domain, platform, workflow and projection owners, database/migrations and the root itself; an owner's compose reaches every role of its own owner in production; every test package reaches its own owner's public, contract, compose, port, adapter and test-support roles, its test support in production the same without test-support, and every test package reaches root-composition and compose; the shared fixtures reach identity-access/adapter. Closes #4001; removes keys of #2750, #3446 and #2748.

atomic_cutover: One PR, policy epoch 40 -> 41, no Go change outside internal/architecture and the policy ratchet test. composition_reach_rule.go adds one acceptance function per reach (reviewedRootCompositionRule, reviewedOwnerCompositionRule, reviewedOwnTestRule, reviewedRootTestRule), wired into ruleLoosenings and the first-party import loosening check; each accepts a rule only in an increased epoch and only when everything the rule allows lies inside the reach. The policy gains 79 rules without issue or ratchet marker (19 root, 22 owner composition, 36 own test and own test support, 1 root test, 1 shared-fixture target identity-access/adapter) and loses 301 rules the reaches cover, four of them temporary (one #2750, three #2747); e2e-test.compose narrows to legacy-composition under #2747. The three root rules into foreign implementation roles become four exact keys under #4003. The twelve listed keys fall: nine #2750 (. -> cmd, cmd -> api, cmd -> tenant, cmd -> database/migrations in production and internal test, api -> observability, internal-test api -> auth/authorize/permissions, api -> realtime, api -> tenant), two #3446 (behavior -> modules/identityaccess, behavior -> legacy/jwt), one #2748 (test -> legacy/jwt). Baseline 54 -> 46 after #4014, policy rules 1,663 -> 1,438, composition surface 252 -> 252, target cycle graph unchanged. No production import, route, query, table or runtime value changes; the imports the reaches now permit already existed.
